Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include<stdio.h>

#include <stdlib.h>

int main()
{
    printf("Enter the month:");
    int entry ;
    scanf("%d",&entry);

    switch (entry)
    {
                    case 12:
                    case 1:
                    case 2:
                          printf("Season: Winter");
                    break;

                    case 3:
                    case 4:
                    case 5:
                    printf("Season: Spring");
                    break;

                    case 6:
                    case 7:
                    case 8:
                    printf("Season: Summer");
                    break;

                    case 9:
                    case 10:
                    case 11:
                    printf("Season: Autumn");
                    break;

                    default:
                    printf("Invalid month");
               }
    return 0;
}
